changes.newText: Enter the keys and click the Save button. The message "SSH Keypair has been successfully registered." confirms the save, and you can now access your Backend.AI session using your own key. If the keypair is rejected, the dialog stays open and shows the error message returned by the server, so you can correct the keys and save again.

changes.newText: Command palette: Adds a Search button to the header and registers the Ctrl+K (⌘K on macOS) shortcut. Both open a palette that searches the pages, tabs, and setting items available to you and moves straight to the one you pick. The palette also lists quick actions -- starting a session, creating a storage folder or a deployment, switching to the light, dark, or system theme, toggling the sidebar, opening notifications or user settings, opening the manual for the current page, and changing the UI language -- and shows the entries you selected most recently under Recent. Results that are available only to administrators are marked Administration or Project administration.
